title: Local vs. remote vs. automatic control
idea: Remote control is running your station from somewhere else, like over the internet. Automatic control is a repeater running on its own. Either way there's a control operator.

items: Operating the station over the internet. Any station may be remotely controlled
Where the control operator function is performed
The one-way link from a remote repeater receiver to the main repeater transmitter

config.heading: What kind of control is it?
config.lead: Pick a setup to see what the rules call it.

situations.label: Running your station over the internet
situations.title: Remote control
situations.text: Operating the station over the internet is the example of remote control. Any station may be remotely controlled, and the control point is wherever you perform the control function.

situations.label: A repeater running on its own
situations.title: Automatic control
situations.text: Repeater operation is the example of automatic control. It still has a control operator: no station ever transmits without one.

situations.label: A computer sends your CW or your ID
situations.title: Not the automatic-control example
situations.text: The pool's example of automatic control is repeater operation, not a computer sending CW or identifying for you.

situations.label: A one-way link from a remote repeater receiver to the main transmitter
situations.title: Auxiliary station
situations.text: One-way transmissions between a remote repeater receiver and the main repeater transmitter come from an auxiliary station.

situations.label: Flying a model aircraft by radio
situations.title: Not remote control of a station
situations.text: Part 97's remote control example is operating your station over the internet. Controlling a model craft is something else.

compare.how: You run the station from elsewhere. Example: over the internet.
The station runs itself. Example: a repeater.
Where you are controlling it, not where the antenna or radio is.

traps.wrong: The location of the station’s transmitting antenna
traps.why: The control point is where the control operator function is performed, not where the antenna is.

traps.wrong: Controlling a station over the internet
traps.why: That's remote control. The automatic-control example is repeater operation.
Any station may be remotely controlled.
An SDR is a kind of radio. Remote control means operating the station over the internet.

traps.wrong: A backup radio for emergency use in case the main station radio fails
traps.why: An auxiliary station is the one-way link from a remote repeater receiver to the main transmitter.
